They come from data you already have: pipeline history and incidents. Compare them against yourself month over month, not against other teams.

Cómo instalar, validar y probar, las con: How to install, validate and test, the conventions and what not to touch. What a new engineer would need on day one, in a few lines. When the agent repeats a mistake, add a line that prevents it; when a line no longer applies, delete it. It's reviewed in PRs like code.
Tantos cambios independientes como pueda: As many independent changes as you can review. The limit is review, not agents. Use one worktree per agent so they don't step on each other's files, and start with two or three: if PRs pile up unreviewed, it's too many.
Para eso están los límites: abre PRs per: That's what the limits are for: it opens PRs but doesn't merge, validates before proposing, and CI runs anyway. The worst case is a PR you close. If it makes the same mistake twice, it's missing context: that goes into CLAUDE.md or a test.
No. Hace la primera pasada (bugs, secret: No. It does the first pass (bugs, secrets, missing tests) and the person reviews design and risk. Human review starts with the mechanical issues already handled and focuses on whether the change is the right one.
Escribe en el CLAUDE.md qué comentar y q: Write in CLAUDE.md what to comment on and what not to, and measure which comments the team ends up accepting. Ask only for comments with evidence (the line, why it fails, how to fix it) and to group minor ones into one. If fewer than half get accepted, adjust the rules.
Nunca: un PR puede traer instrucciones e: Never: a PR can carry hidden instructions to fool the reviewer. That's why the reviewer's token can only comment, and the branch rule requires approval from a person.
QA: escribe los criterios y revisa la su: QA: it writes the criteria and reviews the suite. The agent executes; it doesn't decide what quality is. If the agent proposes changing a criterion so a test passes, QA approves that.
Selectores por rol y texto visible, y el: Role and visible-text selectors, and the agent proposes the fix in a PR that QA reviews. If a test fails only sometimes, it's quarantined and fixed; it isn't retried until it passes.
Si el agente se equivoca leyendo, pierde: If the agent gets it wrong while reading, you lose minutes. If it gets it wrong while acting, you have another incident. With read-only access it can query metrics, logs and deploy history and propose what to do; a person executes the action.

For example: “which services depend on this library and who owns them?”. Building the graph is expensive, so first improve search (hybrid, with reranking) and measure.

Cuando cada llamada repite un contexto g: When every call repeats a large context, like rules or documentation. Reading from the cache costs a fraction of the normal price. Put the fixed context at the start of the prompt and what changes at the end, so the prefix gets reused.
Poca, y a cambio tienes presupuesto, reg: Little, and in exchange you get budgets, logging and a control point. It's usually milliseconds against the seconds the model takes. Put it in the same region as your services and measure it.
En tareas abiertas o que exigen razonar: In open-ended tasks or ones that demand a lot of reasoning, like planning a change across several files or answering open customer questions. It works well for classifying, extracting fields or summarizing in a fixed format.
En una GPU pequeña, en CPU o en una lapt: On a small GPU, on CPU or on a laptop. A quantized 1B–4B parameter model fits in a few GB of memory; with Ollama or llama.cpp you can try it in minutes.
En tareas acotadas puede igualar al gran: On narrow tasks it can match the large one. Measure it with your evals before switching: build a set of 50 to 100 real cases, run it with the current model and the small one, and switch only if the difference is acceptable for that task.

Quality matters more than quantity: reviewed examples, without contradictions, similar to what it will see in production. Hold out a portion for evaluation and don't train on it.

No se puede borrar del adapter: hay que: It can't be deleted from the adapter: you have to retrain without that data. That's why data is cleaned before training: mask names, ID numbers and accounts, and record where each example came from.
Con volumen alto y constante, o cuando l: With high, steady volume, or when data can't leave your network. Do the full math: GPUs running all day, people to operate them and models to update, against the API's per-token cost.
Depende del modelo: uno de 8B cuantizado: It depends on the model: a quantized 8B fits comfortably on a 24 GB GPU. Add memory for context: with many parallel requests or long contexts, the attention cache (KV cache) can need as much as the model.
Alguien de guardia por el servidor de mo: Someone on call for the model server, like for any other service. It needs metrics (latency, queue, GPU memory), alerts, a runbook and a plan to update the model without downtime.
No para todo: sirve para tareas acotadas: Not for everything: it's for narrow or sensitive tasks. A local model with a few billion parameters summarizes, classifies and autocompletes well; for reasoning about a large system, the cloud model still wins.
Con un catálogo de modelos aprobados y v: With a catalog of approved, verified models. Publish them in an internal registry with their hash and license, and block direct downloads from public repos at the network level.
Sí: una vez descargado, el modelo corre: Yes: once downloaded, the model runs without a network. It works on isolated networks or with data that can't leave the machine. Model updates are distributed like any other software.
No. Se limita el daño: permisos mínimos,: No. You limit the damage: least privilege, never combining untrusted content with a way out, and classifiers. Assume some injection will get through and design so the damage is small: an agent that reads external content shouldn't write or send anything without confirmation.
Datos privados, contenido no confiable y: Private data, untrusted content and a way to send data out. If an agent has all three, it can leak information. Example: the agent reads a ticket with a hidden instruction, finds a .env in the repo and sends it inside an image URL. Remove any one of the three and the leak is cut off.
Un clasificador pequeño agrega poco, y p: A small classifier adds little, and it can run in parallel with the main call. If it blocks, you discard the response before showing it. Measure p95 with and without it.
Pedir confirmación antes de cada acción: Asking for confirmation before every action that writes, and allowing without asking only reads and validation commands. In Claude Code that's written as allow, ask and deny rules in .claude/settings.json, versioned with the repo.
Un entorno aislado: sin credenciales de: An isolated environment: no production credentials and limited network. It can be a container or a devcontainer, with only the repo mounted and internet access limited to an allowlist of domains. If something goes wrong, you delete it and recreate it.
No: los complementan con reglas propias,: No: they complement them with your own rules, like blocking rm -rf or reading .env. A hook is a script that runs before or after each tool and can block it; it's for rules that don't fit in a list of commands.
El prompt, cada tool call con sus argume: The prompt, every tool call with its arguments, the results, the model, the cost and who triggered it. With that you can reconstruct what the agent did step by step, even a week later. Use a trace id that travels with the request to join it with your logs.
Enmascáralos antes de guardar y define c: Mask them before storing and define how long they're retained. Do it in the SDK or a collector, before data leaves the service, and limit who can see full traces.
Langfuse es open source y se puede hoste: Langfuse is open source and can be self-hosted; LangSmith comes from the LangChain team. Both work. If you already use OpenTelemetry, check that it accepts those traces so you don't maintain two instrumentations.
Porque el agente tendría todos tus permi: Because the agent would have all your permissions and you couldn't tell what it did from what you did. With its own service account you give it only the permissions for its task, you can revoke it without affecting yourself, and the audit shows what the agent did.
Lee qué herramientas expone, fija la ver: Read which tools it exposes, pin the version and prefer official servers. Check which credentials it asks for and which domains it connects to, and run it with minimal permissions. A new version gets reviewed just like the first one.
Instrucciones escondidas en la descripci: Hidden instructions in an MCP tool's description, which the agent reads and obeys. The user doesn't see that description, but the model does. That's why descriptions are reviewed when approving a server and the version is pinned, so they don't change later.
Es más seguro filtrar en la consulta: lo: It's safer to filter in the query: what isn't retrieved can't leak to the model. If you filter afterward, the document already went through your system and a bug in that filter exposes it. Store the permissions on each chunk and use them as a search condition.
Se trata como datos: nunca da permisos n: It's treated as data: it never grants new permissions or changes the agent's rules. Mark it in the prompt as quoted content, and if the agent can act, actions should depend on the user's request, not on what the document says.
Sincronizándolos desde la fuente en cada: By syncing them from the source on every ingestion. When someone loses access to a document at the source, they must lose it in the index too; measure how long that change takes to arrive.
LiteLLM si quieres open source; Portkey: LiteLLM if you want open source; Portkey or Kong if you prefer something managed. What matters is that every team goes through the same one: pick one you can operate that supports your providers.
Quién llamó, qué modelo, tokens y costo,: Who called, which model, tokens and cost, and the content with personal data masked. With that you can charge costs back to each team, detect abuse and answer which data was sent to which provider.
Las claves de los proveedores solo las t: Only the gateway holds the provider keys. Teams get gateway keys, and the network blocks direct egress to provider APIs.
Bedrock si quieres modelos administrados: Bedrock if you want managed models inside your account; vLLM if you want to serve your own open models. Bedrock removes GPU operations but limits which models are available; vLLM lets you pick any model in exchange for operating it.
Solo safetensors, hash fijo y un escaneo: Only safetensors, a pinned hash and a scan before using it. safetensors doesn't run code when loading, unlike pickle. Record the hash in your catalog and compare it on every deploy.
Que permitan uso comercial. Llama, Qwen: That they allow commercial use. Llama, Qwen and Gemma allow it, each with its own conditions. Check user limits, prohibited uses and whether they require crediting the model; some variants have a license different from the rest of their family.
